October 16, 2024

Private exporters announced three large grain sales to USDA on Wednesday. The first was for 63.9 million bushels of corn to Mexico. Of that total, 64% is for delivery during the current marketing year, with the remainder for delivery in 2025/26.

Private exporters also announced the sale of 13.1 million bushels of corn and 6.4 million bushels of soybeans for delivery to unknown destinations during the 2024/25 marketing year, which began September 1.
